title.narrative: Program beneficiaries with enhanced environmental resilience

baseline.value: Air pollution is an environmental harm that weakens the resilience of 240 million people living and working in Uttar Pradesh. Reduction in air pollution is possible when more and more stakeholders are involved in implementation of air action plan.

target.value: Final reporting of increased number of people in Uttar Pradesh with enhanced environmental resilience from program interventions that reduce primary PM2.5 emissions at households or workplaces.
